author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.14.0 — Adds rotation sweeps: cleanNextRooms() now automatically continues to the next due room once the current one genuinely finishes, working through everything currently due in one trigger instead of requiring a separate call per room, then stops on its own once nothing's left due. dock()/pause()/start() cancel an in-progress sweep. Also reverts the 1.13.0 battery-forced-return detection -- live testing showed a room can legitimately finish with the battery critically low (confirmed against the map at 21%), so that heuristic was a false positive and has been removed; any non-Paused/Error exit is trusted as a genuine finish again.
